editions.label: from the workshop
editions.intro: Three of our apps have had quiet, useful updates since we last wrote. Here is what each one now lets you do.

items.body: Project Manager 5.10.2 keeps a running count of new tasks at the top of your Board. Tap to move between them one by one, and Mark All Seen when you have caught up.
MyLLM 6.6 now runs long jobs on its own and saves its place after each step. You can review every file change before it starts, and set limits on time, tool calls and tokens.
E-Grid 3.1 adds a Live Tab for scores across snooker, darts, tennis and football, plus optional reminders for races and matches you follow and where to watch them.

principles.free: Every Opticell app is free to download. You can install our software and test it on your own device without providing any card details or committing to a purchase. This allows you to judge the utility of the tool before deciding to unlock its full features.
principles.upgrades: You can choose between an ultra-affordable subscription or a one-time lifetime unlock. Both options are entirely opt-in. Subscriptions can be managed or cancelled at any time through your Apple or Google account settings.
principles.pricing: We believe you should know the cost before you commit. Every price is clearly visible on the App Store and Google Play product pages before installation. We also show all costs within the app itself, with no hidden fees or fine print.
principles.privacy: Privacy is our default setting. We do not use analytics to track your usage, nor do we sell information to advertisers or data brokers. Your data stays on your device where it belongs.
principles.ads: Our apps contain no banners, interstitials, or sponsored content. Advertisements compete for your attention and create an incentive for apps to harvest user data. We avoid this model entirely to keep our software focused and clean.
principles.partnership: Where our apps use AI, the technology is designed to extend human capability rather than replace human judgement. The software acts as a tool to assist your workflow, ensuring that you always remain in control of the final outcome.
principles.audience: Our catalogue provides tools for both personal use and professional environments on the same terms. Whether you are using DrawPad for creative work or My Business Portal for organisation, you receive the same honest service.

editions.label: from the workshop
editions.intro: Three of our apps have had fresh updates on the App Store. Here is what changed and why it matters to you.

items.body: Project Manager: a bar at the top of the Board shows how many new tasks have arrived. Show Only New clears the rest, the arrow steps through each card in turn, and Mark All Seen clears them all.
MyLLM: hand it a long job with Run and come back to a report. It plans the work as steps, saves its place after each one, and lets you review or undo every file change before it counts.
E-Grid: a Live tab shows everything on now across your channels, plus what is coming today. Optional alerts remind you before races and matches, and star players tell you when they are next on.

items.body: Project Manager gets two new marketing template packs with client onboarding, a six-week campaign sprint and a monthly reporting cycle. The iPad calendar shows a full month grid with tasks written in each day.

MyLLM can now take a long job and work through it on its own, saving its place after each step. You review the plan first, undo any file change, and set limits on tools, websites, time and tokens before it runs.

E-Grid adds a Live tab with everything happening now across your channels, plus optional reminders before races and matches. Star a player to be told when they are next on screen, and where to watch across all 22 channels.

editions.label: from the workshop
editions.intro: Three Opticell apps have had small updates this week. Here is what each one now does.

items.body: Project Manager 5.10 adds Automations, rules that tag, move or hand over work when tasks change. Six ready-made rules start you off in Settings → Automations. It can also call on Apple Intelligence to summarise a task or draft a reply, privately.

E-Grid 3.1 adds a LIVE TAB for scores and results across your channels, optional SMART ALERTS before races and matches, and WHERE TO WATCH listings. Star a player to be told when they are on next and how they got on.

MyLLM 6.5.2 fixes the message box emptying after you send, even with a spelling suggestion showing. On Mac it now describes your model, macOS version and battery, writes help for mouse and keyboard, drops vibration and brightness controls, and reports which modes are on.
